bugs.text: player.y is never initialised (player object at 263 has no y, no later assignment), so the fighter is never drawn (drawImage with NaN at 866 silently no-ops: no ship in any play screenshot), every player shot starts at y=NaN and is filtered out next tick (377, 594), aimed enemy bullets get vy=NaN and vanish (451-452, 596), and every player collision/capture/dock test is false (681, 700, 628, 647). The player is invisible and invulnerable, cannot hit anything, cannot score, cannot die, cannot clear a stage; score is 0000000 after 75 s in the play-test.

The tractor beam never triggers: a beam dive ends at y=150 but updateEnemies sets state='return' and teleports the boss to y=-14 (523-526) before the beamWant->beamPending check at 640-641 runs (it requires state==='dive'). startBeamDiveMarked (719) is never called; the monkey-patch at 958-959 sets beamWant but it is never consumed. Everything in section E (capture, rescue, dual fighter, hostile captive) is therefore unreachable.
sndHit is defined but never called; no distinct 'enemy hit' sound.
Because shots vanish each tick, holding Space calls fire() every frame: shotsFired inflates by 60/s and sndShot is spammed 60 times per second.

Escort dive: makeDivePath(esc) already starts at the escort's position, then startDive shifts the whole path by esc.slot.x-boss.slot.x again, so escorts teleport sideways by their slot offset when the dive starts.

Latent crash: a completed capture sets b.captive=true (boolean) and the formation branch then does e.captive.animT+=0, a TypeError on a primitive in strict mode. Unreachable only because the beam never fires.
BOSS sprite rows are 12 and 14 characters wide; mk() takes the width from rows[0] (12), so the wider rows are clipped on the right.
Title screen prints '1000 POINTS FOR EVERY' and '20000 POINTS FOR EACH' with no object: leftover text fragments.
Formation sway never stops once the formation is complete; breathing is horizontal scale only.
During READY the entire world (enemies, bullets) is frozen rather than only suppressing dives.
Dead condition `... && false){}` left in the tractor-beam loop.
After the results screen the game waits for Enter rather than returning to the title screen on its own.

summary: The code is tidy in outline: a proper fixed-step loop, data-defined sprites, Catmull-Rom entry and dive paths, a correct 4/16/20 formation, sway and breathe, HUD, title table, badges, challenging-stage sequencing and synthesized sounds are all written out, and the attract screen and formation fly-in look convincingly like Galaga in the screenshots. But one missing field sinks it: the player object never gets a y coordinate, so the fighter is never drawn, shots evaporate the tick they are fired, aimed enemy fire disappears, and nothing can ever hit the player. The result is an invisible, immortal ship facing a formation it cannot damage: score stays zero, no stage can be cleared, no game over, no results screen. Independently of that, the signature tractor-beam mechanic can never start because the dive-end state change runs before the beam trigger check, so capture, rescue and the dual fighter are all dead code, and a latent TypeError waits in the capture path. The remaining logic for scoring, escorts, challenging stages and respawn reads correctly, which is why many items score 1 rather than 0, but as delivered this is a formation demo, not a playable Galaga.
